description: Ministry of Lands & Parliamentary Reforms - Appointed Mrs. U. K. A. Dilhani and two others as acquiring officers for Kalutara District w.e.f. 01.07.2017 to 30.06.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification is primarily about land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints officers under the Land Acquisition Act to handle land acquisitions for specific road projects (Wadduwa-Moronthuduwa Road and Bellana-Moragala Road). While it does mention government personnel appointments, the core subject matter is land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters rather than general government personnel changes or structural reforms.
